tldr: the Sun through the 7th house brings attention to partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 7th house, it brings attention to partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
